fact: Italic is one property of the whole text element, set with an "Italic" toggle in the properties panel or Ctrl+I (Cmd+I on macOS); there is no partial italic, no separate italic font, and bold is out of scope.

fact: The "Italic" toggle sits next to the text align control with tooltip "Italic (Ctrl+I)" and is shown when a text, a shape with text or an arrow with a label is selected, or the Text tool is active; it is never disabled, for any font.
